task.instruction: Check the leaderboard for Golf's DP World Tour in the SPORT section, what was the name of the most recent tournament, and how many teams have a Total of -10 strokes.

final_answer:
The most recent tournament on the DP World Tour leaderboard is the **Abu Dhabi Championship** (5–8 November 2026, Yas Links, par 72, $9,000,000 prize money — currently live, last updated 7 November 2026 at 07:13 UK time).

On the Total column, **2 entries are at -10 strokes (10 under par)**: Bernd Wiesberger (Austria) and David Puig (Spain), both tied for 8th with 134 strokes after two rounds.

Note: this BBC leaderboard is an individual strokeplay table rather than a team event, so the "teams" at -10 are those two players.

judge.rationale: Final page shows DP World Tour leaderboard for Abu Dhabi Championship and exactly two -10 totals: Bernd Wiesberger and David Puig.
